$comment: The allowed import arrows between backend domains (apps/backend/src/domains/<name>), keyed by the importing domain. Held by domain-boundaries.spec.ts: an import along an arrow not listed here fails, and so does a listed arrow nothing uses. A new arrow is a deliberate edit reviewed with the code; prefer a domain event to a sideways import. Optional-feature keys are dropped by tools/init-app/apply-feature.mjs (allowlistPrefixes in tools/init-app/features/<name>.json).
